feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: Government spent $10 million on pro-Trump ads after president said super PAC would fund
entry.summary: Nearly $22 million in taxpayers funds has been spent to air the ads, with nearly half spent after Trump promised to fund what the White House calls public service announcements through his super PAC.

entry.title: Actor Selma Blair removed from plane by police after altercation
entry.summary: Authorities say Blair was physically abusive and injured two flight attendants while traveling from Los Angeles to New York. A Blair representative said she had a medical emergency aboard the plane.

entry.title: U.S. restrictions on Chinese drones are hurting cash-strapped police departments
entry.summary: The U.S. government is trying to end the dominance of high-quality, low-cost drones made in China. But more restrictions mean higher costs for cash-strapped police forces that rely on those drones.

entry.title: Yale Law expert on Hegseth's plans to livestream execution
entry.summary: Military justice expert Eugene Fidell of Yale Law School speaks to NPR about the Pentagon's plan to livestream the execution of a convicted mass murderer.

entry.title: Tropical Storm Rachel downgraded as high winds and rain turn inward
entry.summary: Forecasters say the storm, which brought heavy rain and coastal flooding, is a preview of what may be in store as California braces for a possibly record-setting El Niño.

entry.title: Demand rising for death doulas, who help with end-of-life care
entry.summary: Death doulas are non-medical professionals who help with end-of-life care. And their numbers are growing.

entry.title: Pope Leo XIV to undergo lung surgery this week
entry.summary: Pope Leo XIV said he would undergo surgery after doctors found a "localized nodule" in his lung.

entry.title: Justice Department investigates TV networks, citing possible anti-trust violations
entry.summary: The move escalates Trump's fight with the press amid court battle over barring CNN, Politico and MS NOW from the White House.

entry.title: How Trump reshaped the DOJ's Civil Rights Division to serve his agenda
entry.summary: The Civil Rights Division, long the crown jewel of the Justice Department, has been radically reshaped under President Trump, using its enforcement powers to pursue the president's MAGA agenda.

entry.title: Reshaped civil rights mission at Justice Department transforms its work, workforce
entry.summary: Harmeet Dhillon has pushed out hundreds of longtime attorneys, replaced many with inexperienced ideological allies, and used the division's enforcement powers to pursue the president's agenda.
